name: Chrome Extension Build Prompt (Time Tracker)
query: I want a chrome extension that tracks how much time I spend on each site and nudges me when I'm on Twitter too long
expected_behavior: Step 1: Proceeds without interrogating (idea is clear enough), or asks at most 1-2 sharp questions
Step 2: Checks feasibility (browser-only tracking is fine; flags that time outside Chrome isn't visible)
Step 3: Classifies as Tracking + Behavioral nudge and reads references/mv3-playbook.md
Step 4: Writes the prompt using the template: named product, CORE FUNCTIONALITY, DESIGN DIRECTION
Step 5: Delivers the prompt in a code block with 1-2 short notes
success_criteria: Prompt gives the extension a short, evocative product name
Includes the MV3 service-worker constraint: no setInterval, timestamps persisted to chrome.storage.local
Mentions chrome.idle and window focus events for accurate tracking
Design section is at least as long as functionality section and names the heart UI surface
Scopes tracker and nudge into milestones or keeps nudge lightweight
No file structures or function names beyond playbook one-liners
Ends with a request for unpacked install instructions
